topic: the 1908 Tunguska explosion -- 80 million trees flattened by a blast with no crater
title: The 1908 Blast That Flattened 80 Million Trees, No Crater Found
description: AI-narrated history commentary: the true story of the 1908 Tunguska event, an explosion over Siberia powerful enough to flatten 80 million trees across 2,000 square kilometers -- with no impact crater ever found.

hook_candidates.text: An explosion in 1908 flattened 80 million trees, and it left no crater at all.
You think a blast that levels a forest needs to hit the ground. This one never did.
What explosion levels 2,000 square kilometers of forest and leaves no crater behind?
In 1908, something exploded over Siberia with the force of a thousand Hiroshimas.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who thinks every huge explosion leaves a crater, because they want proof one leveled a forest without one.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume any explosion that flattens 80 million trees leaves a crater.
closing_comment: That 1908 Siberian blast flattened 80 million trees without leaving any crater.

sources.note: Confirms 1908 date, roughly 2,000 sq km of forest flattened, and no impact crater ever found.
Confirms the energy estimate up to 15 megatons and the airburst explanation for the missing crater.
